record.context_brief: Finite unions in the Borel case
record.original_question: Is the Borel-cover property S_fin(B_Ω, B_Ω) consistently closed under finite unions?

evidence.quote: Problem 8.5 ([60]). Is Sfin(BΩ, BΩ) consistently closed under taking finite unions?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be an uncountable separable metrizable (in particular, a set of reals) space. A collection U of subsets of X is called an ω-cover of X if X ∉ U and every finite subset of X is contained in some member of U. Let B_Ω(X) denote the family of all countable ω-covers of X whose members are Borel subsets of X.

For families A and B of covers, the selection principle S_fin(A, B) asserts: for every sequence (U_n)_{n∈ω} with U_n ∈ A, there exist finite subfamilies F_n ⊆ U_n such that ⋃_{n∈ω} F_n ∈ B.

Say that a topological property P is closed under finite unions if, whenever X = Y ∪ Z with Y and Z having property P (as subspaces, or equivalently when X is a set of reals, as subsets), then X has property P.

Question: Is it consistent with the usual axioms of ZFC that the property S_fin(B_Ω, B_Ω) (i.e., the class of separable metrizable spaces X satisfying S_fin(B_Ω(X), B_Ω(X))) is closed under taking finite unions?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a definitive resolution of the consistency question for closure of S_fin(B_Ω, B_Ω) under finite unions. Related selection-principle literature (Scheepers, Tsaban, and follow-ups) discusses additivity questions for Borel-cover selection principles, but no source consulted confirms either a positive consistency result or a ZFC obstruction specifically for S_fin(B_Ω, B_Ω). Status appears unresolved based on available evidence.

status_evidence.title: Selection principles and proofs from the Book
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses selection principles S_fin(A,B) and properties including closure conditions, without resolving the Borel ω-cover additivity question.
status_evidence.claim: General survey context for S_fin-type principles; no resolution of the specific consistency question is given.

status_evidence.title: Certain observations on selection principles related to bornological covers using ideals
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on selection principles for various cover families; does not announce a resolution of additivity for S_fin(B_Ω, B_Ω).
status_evidence.claim: Recent related work does not report a solution to the consistency-of-finite-additivity problem for S_fin(B_Ω, B_Ω).
